title: Dungeon Delvers
premise: Four kids dive an endless dungeon whose floors go below zero: loot, traps, bosses, portals and mirror rooms.

companion.name: PIP
companion.about: a lantern sprite, tiny and bright, cheerful and a little dramatic

cast.KWAME: tank; big-hearted, always walks into the trap first
cast.SOL: mapmaker; careful, loves grids and coordinates
cast.BAO: healer; calm, funny, tracks everyone's health
cast.GRIMBLE: the dungeon's goblin shopkeeper; sly, sells bad maps

gag: Kwame always walks into the trap first.

fragments.style: Middle-grade graphic novel panel, clean cel-shaded coloring, bold black ink outlines, rounded cartoon characters with big expressive faces, rich saturated colors, torchlit stone grey, emerald and warm orange palette
fragments.notext: Wordless art, all surfaces blank, no lettering, no numbers, no speech bubbles, one single continuous scene filling the whole image with no panel borders, frames, bands or split sections
fragments.anya: a girl age 11 with light brown skin, short spiky dark hair and a forest green hooded cloak over a leather vest
fragments.kwame: a big friendly boy age 11 with dark brown skin, a shaved head and a dented silver chest plate over a red tunic, holding a round wooden shield
fragments.sol: a girl age 11 with tan skin, two long dark braids, round goggles pushed up on her head, a tan explorer coat and a rolled map under her arm
fragments.bao: a boy age 11 with light skin, black bowl-cut hair and a sky blue robe with a satchel of potion bottles
fragments.pip: a tiny glowing lantern sprite, a round flame-orange spirit with big dot eyes floating inside a little brass lantern cage
fragments.grimble: a short green goblin shopkeeper with big ears, a tiny monocle and a patched brown vest
fragments.dungeon: an underground stone dungeon with torches, mossy stone walls, carved stone doors and a spiral staircase going down
